The '''subjugation of Ithor''' occurred in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The advent of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] activity around [[Ithor/Legends|Ithorian]] space brought the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Conquest (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Conquest'']] into [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] over the forest [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The opportunistic [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alima]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] then laid siege to Ithor. Alima sought to obtain the secrets of Ithorian technology. When [[High Priest/Legends|High Priest]] [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] initially refused, Alima ordered the [[Bafforr tree|bafforr forest]] of [[Cathor Hills]] to be fired on. Thousands of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]] were killed in the resulting inferno. When Alima then turned his guns on the ''[[Tafanda Bay]]'', Nadon gave in to his demands.

Following this incident, the [[Council of Ithorian Elders|Ithor Council]] excommunicated Nadon from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], and he lived a number of years on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The incident also resulted in many Ithorians clandestinely supporting the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
